description: PREREGISTERED test of the final A3 candidate on the Gold 150 set: A3v2_2e = A3 v2.1.1 reviewer + guard 0.3 (G3b) + quote check 1.1 + decidability gate (G1, G4) + D-sup + A3-side numeric checks (N1, N2) + E1 evidence coverage. Runs only once the preregistration is locked; no change after seeing results.
